destination.title: Charged gravitational objects: solutions, extremality, forces and observables
destination.question: How do charge, matter content and gravitational dynamics shape black-hole and black-brane solutions, their interactions, stability, thermodynamics and observable signatures?

sources.title: Blackfolds in Supergravity and String Theory

evidence.text: How can blackfold dynamics incorporate charged black branes and dissolved lower-brane currents, construct rotating black holes, and characterize their extremal limits and stability?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture and extremal black holes

evidence.text: Can charged-particle one-loop corrections to extremal black-hole geometry and entropy diagnose Weak Gravity Conjecture violations, motivate its magnetic cutoff, or reveal the large microscopic entropy suggested for attractive charged matter?

sources.title: Anomaly induced quantum correction to charged black holes; geometry and thermodynamics

evidence.text: How does the curvature-induced trace anomaly modify the static Reissner–Nordström geometry, extremality boundary, thermodynamics, thermal equilibrium, and charged-shell collapse, particularly near zero charge and Planck-scale mass?

sources.title: A Stringy Test of the Scalar Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Massless scalars can affect black-hole extremality through gauge couplings and affect probe interactions through derivatives of the probe mass. The effective theory keeps these two mechanisms distinct before imposing a relation between them.

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: How should charge and gauge coupling be normalized when comparing particle forces, black-hole extremality and quantum-gravity bounds? Integer matter charges fix a convention that the pure Einstein–Maxwell action does not determine.

sources.title: The Black Hole Weak Gravity Conjecture with Multiple Charges

evidence.text: The EFT isolates how heavy physics changes black-hole extremality when the only massless matter consists of N Abelian photons. General electric and magnetic charges allow the calculation to probe parity-odd interactions that purely electric solutions cannot detect.

sources.title: Charged black holes in Einsteinian cubic gravity and nonuniqueness

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional Einsteinian cubic gravity minimally coupled to Maxwell electrodynamics support distinct asymptotically flat black holes with identical mass and charge, and how do their horizons, thermodynamics and horizonless counterparts behave?

sources.title: Comments on magnetic black holes

evidence.text: How do strong magnetic fields modify extremal and near-extremal Standard Model black holes, particularly their electroweak vacuum, low-energy fermions, stability and Hawking emission?

sources.title: Phenomenology of magnetic black holes with electroweak-symmetric coronas

evidence.text: How abundant can primordial, nearly extremal magnetic black holes with electroweak-symmetric coronas be, and how can galactic magnetic fields, neutrinos and astrophysical heating constrain them?

sources.title: Singular limits in STU supergravity

evidence.text: How do singular limits connect gauged STU theories and their higher-dimensional embeddings, and how can these relations produce charged black holes with domain-wall asymptotics?

sources.title: Charge (in)stability and superradiance of Topological Stars

evidence.text: Do electrically charged winding-string scalar probes destabilize Topological Stars or Black Strings, and which of these backgrounds exhibits charge-superradiant amplification?

sources.title: Charged black holes in Einstein-Weyl-Maxwell theory

evidence.text: How do the two numerical charged black-hole branches connect to the intersecting neutral Schwarzschild and non-Schwarzschild branches? How do they relate to RN, which is not an exact solution, and what are their thermodynamic, scalar-perturbation and near-extremal properties?

sources.title: Charged rotating quantum black holes

evidence.text: How do simultaneous charge and rotation affect braneworld quantum-black-hole thermodynamics, criticality, semiclassical validity, quantum inequalities and the gyromagnetic ratio?

sources.title: CUDA Assisted Swampland and Black Hole Thermodynamics

evidence.text: Can CUDA-assisted horizon and thermodynamic calculations connect electric charge, mass and scalar-modulus values to weak-gravity-conjecture bounds and stabilization of charged black holes?

sources.title: Ehlers-Harrison transformations and black holes in dilaton - axion gravity with multiple vector fields

evidence.text: Construct U-duality solution-generating transformations for dilaton–axion gravity with multiple vector fields, and classify nonrotating black-hole geometries and BPS limits by charge alignment.

sources.title: Charged rotating black holes in four-dimensional gauged and ungauged supergravities

evidence.text: Construct complete non-extremal rotating four-dimensional black-hole solutions, including gauge potentials, with four independent ungauged charges; obtain gauged extensions with pairwise-equal charges and explore NUT and acceleration parameters.

sources.title: Black holes with quantum massive spin-2 hair

evidence.text: Can black holes carry classically invisible, topological quantum hair under massive spin-2 fields, detectable at arbitrarily large distances, and what conditions govern analogous massive two-form and photon effects?

sources.title: Higher-order corrections to mass-charge relation of extremal black holes

evidence.text: How does a massless dilaton alter extremality and the no-force condition? In the magnetic GHS background, scalar attraction participates in the classical cancellation, so a corrected mass alone cannot determine the sign of the interaction.

sources.title: Higher-order corrections to mass-charge relation of extremal black holes

evidence.text: What classical background and charge normalization define the extremality shift? The calculation fixes the asymptotic mass and Maxwell flux in static, spherical, asymptotically flat Einstein-Maxwell theory in D>3 dimensions.

sources.title: Black Holes with Flavors of Quantum Hair?

evidence.text: Can massive tensor fields furnish classically invisible black-hole quantum hair detectable at long distance, possibly with ordinary magnetic solenoids, and how does higher-dimensional topology constrain the measurable charges of a KK tower?

sources.title: Quantum hair on black holes

evidence.text: Can black holes carry observable quantum numbers without associated massless gauge fields, and how do screened electric and magnetic charges affect exterior observables and thermodynamics?

sources.title: Black hole remnants and the information puzzle

evidence.text: Does an infinite degeneracy of extremal magnetic black-hole states necessarily imply divergent production, or can extended throat geometry evade that objection and retain information from particle–black-hole scattering?

sources.title: Blackfolds in Supergravity and String Theory

evidence.text: Combine intrinsic stress-energy/current conservation with extrinsic embedding equations K_ab^ρ T^ab=0. Equations of state and charge responses are extracted from explicit supergravity black-brane solutions.

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture and extremal black holes

evidence.text: Factorize heat kernels on AdS2×S² and derive small-proper-time expansions using spectral densities, contour integration, and zeta-function sums. Charged densities require distinct intermediate- and large-black-hole expansions.

sources.title: Anomaly induced quantum correction to charged black holes; geometry and thermodynamics

evidence.text: Impose radial-boost invariance and stress-tensor conservation, expand diagonal components in inverse powers of r, and infer their coefficients from the trace. Evaluate this source on the classical RN metric before integrating the first metric correction.

sources.title: A Stringy Test of the Scalar Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Decompose the indexed generating function into theta cosets, select the neutral coset, and track both the quadratic charge exponent and the prefactor's seed. A nonvanishing seed converts formal theta support into populated spectral sectors.

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: Evaluate proposed constraints against controlled constructions and independently motivated infrared arguments, recording assumptions and construction quality. The review distinguishes complete worldsheet constructions from more assumption-dependent string-inspired models and treats their agreement as graded evidence.

sources.title: The Black Hole Weak Gravity Conjecture with Multiple Charges

evidence.text: Compare photon propagation with the light cone, or use analyticity and unitarity to express coefficient combinations through positive absorptive data. The paper reviews their common inequality and distinguishes it from charge-space quartic positivity.

sources.title: Non-Abelian magnetized blackholes and unstable attractors

evidence.text: Do unstable non-Abelian gauge fluctuations around magnetic monopoles survive coupling to gravity and dilatons, including in charged blackholes and their near-horizon geometries, and what does this imply for applying the attractor mechanism?

sources.title: Geons with spin and charge

evidence.text: Which higher-dimensional eternal black holes admit single-asymptotic-region geon quotients carrying gauge charge or angular momentum, and what restrictions follow from dimension, orientability and gauge-bundle topology?

sources.title: Black holes with electroweak hair: The detailed derivation

evidence.text: Can gravity coupled to the physical electroweak theory support magnetically charged black holes with massive-field hair, and what determines their structure, energetics and extremal limits?

sources.title: Long-range forces between nonidentical black holes with non-BPS extremal limits

evidence.text: How do long-range forces between nonidentical charged black holes with non-BPS extremal limits depend on charge ratios and nonextremality, and when can they vanish?

sources.title: A Chern-Simons Pandemic

evidence.text: Can an unlimited collection of globally charged black-hole states coexist with a sensible quantum theory of gravity?

sources.title: Forced Fluid Dynamics from Blackfolds in General Supergravity Backgrounds

evidence.text: How do arbitrary background geometry, fluxes and dilaton profiles force the leading collective dynamics of charged black branes, and how do the resulting equations emerge from gravity and hydrostatic actions?

sources.title: Effective metric description of charged black holes

evidence.text: How can invariant effective metric deformations describe charged static black holes, including extremality, and what local horizon conditions follow from finite temperature, curvature and a physically admissible exterior?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Do causality-favored electromagnetic interactions lower extremal black-hole masses within a specified conserved-charge sector?

sources.title: A Semiclassical, Entropic Proof of a Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: The background permits a semiclassical test of a charged scalar whose mass is too large to discharge an extremal black hole along a chosen charge direction. A large radius suppresses curvature while the charge projection q·Q can remain large.

sources.title: A Weak Gravity Theorem

evidence.text: Historical question of the withdrawn manuscript: can field-theoretic dispersion relations constrain higher-derivative Einstein–Maxwell coefficients so large extremal black holes approach Q/M=1 from above and can decay into smaller charged black holes?

sources.title: Black Holes, Moduli, and Long-Range Forces

evidence.text: Does the vanishing long-range force between identical extremal Reissner-Nordström black holes generalize to charged black holes and black branes with arbitrary moduli and multiple gauge fields, and which notion of extremality controls that force?

sources.title: Searching for Magnetic Monopoles with the Earth’s Magnetic Field

evidence.text: Can the monopole component of Earth's magnetic field constrain its enclosed net magnetic charge, and thereby constrain captured magnetic monopoles or highly magnetically charged black holes?

sources.title: On the black hole weak gravity conjecture and extremality in the strong-field regime

evidence.text: What conditions permit extremal black-hole decay beyond the weak-field EFT regime, and what does the conjectured decay of every extremal black hole imply for strong-field electrodynamics, gauge-coupling running, and candidate Maxwell-sector completions?

sources.title: The Instability of charged black strings and p-branes

evidence.text: Does magnetic charge stabilize the long-wavelength instability of black strings and p-branes in low-energy string gravity, and how do growing modes change with charge?

sources.title: Generalized Komar charges and Smarr formulas for black holes and boson stars

evidence.text: How can generalized Komar charges and other surface charges constrain gravitational solitons and boson stars, and how do matter fields invariant under combined spacetime and global transformations modify these constraints and black-hole Smarr formulas?

sources.title: The quantum mass gap of extremal black holes

evidence.text: Can a semiclassical shell-lowering experiment explain a characteristic near-extremal Reissner–Nordström energy scale proportional to ħ²/M³ without string-theory calculations or holography?

sources.title: Force-free higher derivative Einstein-Maxwell theory and multi-centered black holes

evidence.text: Which four-derivative Einstein–Maxwell interactions admit static multicentered extremal black holes with position-independent energy, and are their force-free constraints stronger than preservation of the extremal mass–charge ratio?

evidence.text: Does modular invariance force charged states below a universal energy bound in a 2d CFT with an abelian current, and constrain their energy-to-charge ratio? What follows for charged spectra in AdS3 gravity?

sources.title: Anomalies and Bounds on Charged Operators

evidence.text: Does a global symmetry's ’t Hooft anomaly constrain the scaling dimension of the lightest charged local operator, and determine whether a universal upper bound exists?

sources.title: Universal Bounds on Charged States in 2d CFT and 3d Gravity

evidence.text: Construct linear combinations of temperature and chemical-potential derivatives at τ=i, z=0. Positivity on neutral states and sufficiently heavy charged states forces a charged contribution below the functional's gap threshold.

sources.title: Anomalies and Bounds on Charged Operators

evidence.text: Modular S crossing for the vector (Z+,Z−,ZL), expanded in Virasoro characters with nonnegative degeneracies. Derivative linear functionals at τ=−τ̄=i exclude proposed spectral gaps by positivity. Integrality of degeneracies is not used.

sources.title: Universal Bounds on Charged States in 2d CFT and 3d Gravity

evidence.text: An alternative argument forms W4=Z∂z⁴Z−3(∂z²Z)² and divides by a modular discriminant power. The supersymmetric argument instead uses holomorphic elliptic genera and the weight-four modular-form space for Γ0(2).

sources.title: Universal Bounds on Charged States in 2d CFT and 3d Gravity

evidence.text: Use universal modular covariance of the flavored partition function. The argument invokes current algebra order by order in chemical potential; a compact free boson supplies an explicit transformation through Poisson resummation.

sources.title: Anomalies and Bounds on Charged Operators

evidence.text: The analytic charged-gap construction uses only scaling dimensions, imaginary τ and cubic derivative functionals, replacing the full defect spin rule by its dimension lower bound. Cardy asymptotics motivate cancellations between heavy even and odd states but alone provide no quantitative validity regime.

evidence.text: What constraints does modular covariance of flavored two-dimensional CFT partition functions impose on charged dimensions, charge gaps, charge-to-mass ratios and representation content, and can extremal spectra determine candidate partition functions?

sources.title: Towards a Swampland Global Symmetry Conjecture using weak gravity

evidence.text: Can bulk charge propagation break an apparent global symmetry on one boundary? A Higgs expectation value on the opposite boundary permits charge transfer through a WGC-required charged bulk field.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Cardy formula and the Weak Gravity Conjecture in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Can a modified AdS5/CFT4 Weak Gravity Conjecture hold for every 4d N=1 SCFT, including theories without a weakly coupled Einstein gravity dual, while resolving known chiral-sector counterexamples?

sources.title: Towards a Swampland Global Symmetry Conjecture using weak gravity

evidence.text: Write H=ve^(iφ), expand its explicit breaking terms inside the path integral, and compare the weights with instanton weights. Gauging requires additional charged matter dressing.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Cardy formula and the Weak Gravity Conjecture in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Reviews matrix-integral saddle-point and anomaly-based effective-field-theory treatments of the supersymmetric Cardy limit, followed by a Legendre transform to obtain large-angular-momentum entropy.

sources.title: Towards a Swampland Global Symmetry Conjecture using weak gravity

evidence.text: Estimate a localized geometry's action from its size, then assess whether the path integral is dominated by the smallest admissible objects. This operation compares several proposed symmetry-breaking mechanisms.

sources.title: Towards a Swampland Global Symmetry Conjecture using weak gravity

evidence.text: Attach a charged worldvolume to a charged defect to restore gauge invariance. An axion instanton becomes a charged-worldline endpoint, and summing its positions produces a local matter-dressed operator.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Cardy formula and the Weak Gravity Conjecture in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Orthogonalizes flavor currents by Gram-Schmidt, constructs convex hulls from extreme charge-to-dimension vectors of chiral gauge-invariant operators, and evaluates their minimum distance from the origin.

sources.title: Supersymmetric Cardy formula and the Weak Gravity Conjecture in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: Uses anomaly cancellation to identify flavor symmetries and determine R-charges where possible; otherwise applies a-maximization to obtain superconformal R-charges and anomaly central charges.

sources.title: Superadditivity at large charge

evidence.text: Does the minimal charged-operator dimension satisfy Δ((n1+n2)q0) ≥ Δ(n1q0)+Δ(n2q0) for positive integers n1,n2, particularly at large charge? The paper examines the required charge spacing q0 and whether bottom-up EFT consistency can establish this conjecture.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture in the AdS/CFT correspondence

evidence.text: How should the weak gravity conjecture be generalized to AdS, what inequalities follow for charged CFT operators and central charges, and can those inequalities hold for every CFT rather than only theories admitting weakly coupled gravitational descriptions?

sources.title: The Weak Gravity Conjecture in three dimensions

evidence.text: Do compactness of a bulk U(1) and modular invariance of its holographic CFT force charged states below the AdS3 black-hole threshold, and what additional constraints apply to residual ZN charge sectors?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: How should the conjecture constrain spectra with several independent conserved gauge charges?

sources.title: Weak Gravity Conjecture, Central Charges and $\eta/s$

evidence.text: Does an assumed AdS weak gravity conjecture constrain higher-derivative couplings sufficiently to enforce the KSS bound at extremality, and how do these constraints interact with holographic central-charge bounds?

sources.title: Convexity of charged operators in CFTs and the weak gravity conjecture

evidence.text: Can a weak-gravity principle formulated through nonnegative self-binding energy motivate a universal constraint on the lowest dimensions of charged CFT operators, including theories without weakly curved gravitational duals?

sources.title: Large N Gauge Theories with a Dense Spectrum and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can large-N gauge theories have a densely populated low-dimensional operator spectrum and O(N) central charges, and do proposed AdS Weak Gravity Conjecture inequalities hold when a weakly coupled Einstein gravity dual is unavailable?

sources.title: ISCOs and the weak gravity conjecture bound in higher derivative theories of gravity

evidence.text: Can charged-probe binding energies and heavy-light CFT anomalous dimensions yield WGC bounds in higher-derivative AdS gravity, and does the disappearance of physical ISCOs coincide with those bounds?

sources.title: Universal Bounds on Charged States in 2d CFT and 3d Gravity

evidence.text: Does modular invariance force charged states below a universal energy bound in a 2d CFT with an abelian current, and constrain their energy-to-charge ratio? What follows for charged spectra in AdS3 gravity?

sources.title: More on the weak gravity conjecture via convexity of charged operators

evidence.text: Test ordinary convexity through nonnegative second derivatives on twice-differentiable intervals, then infer superadditivity using the imported Petrovic theorem with Δ(0)=0. At kinks, the source requires returning to the definition rather than applying the derivative criterion across the singular point.

sources.title: Convexity of charged operators in CFTs with multiple Abelian symmetries

evidence.text: Computes sublattice cell-volume ratios using determinants after mapping the full operator-charge lattice to an integer basis. This measure is invariant under changes of lattice basis and simultaneous invertible linear transformations, including current rescaling.

sources.title: A counterexample to the CFT convexity conjecture

evidence.text: Use perturbative beta functions for general quartic single-trace superpotential couplings, with leading contributions controlled by the superpotential and γΦ. Solve the fixed-point equations for the nearest-neighbor chain and check positivity of each squared coupling.

sources.title: Goldstone bosons and convexity

evidence.text: A fixed-charge Euclidean path integral, projected to its lowest-energy contribution as β→∞, supplies the semiclassical Legendre relations Q=∂L/∂m and E=mQ−L. The alternative expectation-value argument uses superpositions, external currents, Hölder's inequality and convex conjugation.

sources.title: Tests of the Charge Convexity Conjecture in Caswell-Banks-Zaks theory

evidence.text: Separate intra-meson from inter-meson diagrams. Large-N factorization makes the latter suppressed by 1/N; without operator mixing, intra-meson contributions cancel in γ(double meson)−2γ(single meson). With mixing, compare the relevant eigenvalues instead.

sources.title: More on the weak gravity conjecture via convexity of charged operators

evidence.text: Combine analytic leading semiclassical expressions, numerical next-order sums and plots, one-loop superadditivity differences, and small-/large-charge limits. The authors use semiclassics particularly to bridge the intermediate regime where ordinary perturbation and large-charge EFT are insufficient.
